features.name: norm_temp_diff
features.description: Normalized difference between air and water temperature, creating a scale-invariant distance metric for thermal conditions.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a bounded, normalized feature that prevents large temperature magnitudes from dominating the KNN distance metric.

features.name: recent_precip_intensity
features.description: Ratio of 1-day precipitation to 5-day precipitation, representing the temporal concentration of recent rainfall.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a bounded ratio that groups sites with similar recent weather patterns, improving neighborhood geometry.

features.name: livestock_proximity_score
features.description: Inverse distance to any livestock, converting an unbounded distance into a bounded proximity score.
features.expected_model_benefit: Inverts distance to create a bounded proximity score, preventing large spatial distances from skewing the KNN metric.

features.name: human_impact_index
features.description: Aggregated indicator of human impact based on the presence of wastewater, stormwater outfalls, and trailers.
features.expected_model_benefit: Aggregates binary indicators into a discrete ordinal scale, grouping similar sites in the feature space.

features.name: water_quality_anomaly
features.description: Euclidean distance from typical pH (7.8) and DO (8.0) values, acting as an unsupervised prototype distance.
features.expected_model_benefit: Computes a distance from a generic unsupervised prototype, providing a continuous similarity metric for water quality.

features.name: solar_radiation_trend
features.description: Ratio of short-term (1-day) to long-term (30-day) solar radiation.
features.expected_model_benefit: Normalizes short-term solar radiation against the long-term baseline, providing a stable similarity metric.

features.name: developed_land_ratio
features.description: Ratio of developed land cover (X21, X22) to forest and wetland cover (forwet) in the watershed.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a scale-normalized ratio of developed to natural land cover, improving neighborhood geometry by focusing on relative composition.

features.name: buffer_development_intensity
features.description: Ratio of developed land cover to forest and wetland cover within a 60m buffer.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a fine-grained spatial similarity metric by normalizing local land cover composition.

features.name: microbial_source_presence
features.description: Sum of human (HF183) and ruminant (Rum2Bac) microbial source tracking markers.
features.expected_model_benefit: Aggregates sparse binary markers into a single ordinal feature, reducing dimensionality and improving distance calculations.

features.name: turbidity_flow_interaction
features.description: Interaction term between turbidity and flow, capturing the combined effect of water movement and suspended particles.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures the non-linear relationship between flow and turbidity in a single continuous feature, useful for identifying similar flush events.

features.name: semantic_site_vulnerability
features.description: Semantic assessment of the overall vulnerability of the site based on land use, soil type, and proximity to potential contamination sources.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a semantic similarity axis for KNN, grouping sites with similar holistic vulnerability profiles.

features.name: semantic_weather_flush_potential
features.description: Semantic assessment of the likelihood of a recent flush event based on precipitation history, solar radiation, and temperature trends.
features.expected_model_benefit: Groups sites with similar recent weather patterns, providing a complex temporal similarity metric that is difficult to capture with simple formulas.
